prompt: Retrieve the implementation of a concept expressed with different words than the source code while preserving the Context token budget.
expected_behavior: With an explicitly configured matching local embedding model, Vector retrieval recalls the relevant Chunk that BM25 and structural retrieval miss, three-channel RRF retains the raw lexical/structural/vector scores, and Context still admits only complete Evidence within token_budget.
assertions: lexical and structural retrieval do not place the target in the baseline top-k
vector retrieval places the target in the hybrid top-k
the target reports a vector score and fused score
the result reports provider/model/dimensions, indexed vector count, query embedding count, and failure policy
